title: moebius-transcendental-lean: the conjugation degree on the transcendental locus
description:
A Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization of the conjugation degree δ(z) = [Q̄(z, conj z) : Q̄(z)] on the transcendental locus T = C \ Q̄, under the action of the group generated by PGL(2, Q̄) and complex conjugation.

This release is early and deliberately under-claims. Five declarations are proved and sorry-free: Qbar, mem_Qbar_iff, Transcendentals, gen, and the multiplicity API shiftTo, mult, nonempty_of_ne_zero, shiftTo_ne_zero. The last of these assembles the multiplicity of a point on a plane curve from MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent, which Mathlib does not otherwise provide. Two declarations are definitions with no results yet attached: conjDegree and stratum.

What is not proved. Four elementary statements are written down in the accompanying note but not formalized. One theorem, identifying the conjugation degree with the classical circular degree of a plane curve, is out of reach in Mathlib today: Bézout's theorem for plane curves, normalization of a projective curve, and the degree of a morphism are all absent at the pinned revision. The note tex/ground-up.tex states every result with its status — the Lean declaration that proves it, or an explicit note that it is stated and not proved. Nothing not so marked is claimed.

Reproducibility. Pinned to leanprover/lean4:v4.32.0 with Mathlib at revision 81a5d257c8e410db227a6665ed08f64fea08e997. The pin is deliberate: lean4export tracks no v4.32.1 or v4.32.2, and Lean refuses oleans built by a different toolchain, so a project on an untracked patch release cannot be exported.

AI assistance. The mathematics, the formalization and the accompanying note were produced with substantial assistance from large language models, directed and accepted by the author, who is responsible for the content. Every declaration marked proved is machine-checked by Lean 4 at the pinned toolchain; no statement marked proved rests on an assertion by a model.
